He set the note on his table beside the logbook, poured himself tea, and watched the horizon brighten, feeling, for once, companioned.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一座沉睡的巨兽，呼吸缓慢而深沉。街灯仍亮着，映照着空无一人的马路，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，留下短暂的光痕。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽袅袅升起，一个人影在里面忙碌。远处的高楼只剩下零星的窗户亮着，不知是加班还是失眠。天色尚暗，但东方已泛起一丝微蓝。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。这是城市最安静的时刻，也是它悄悄苏醒的前奏。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a smaller version of itself, like looking inside a box that has a smaller box inside.\n- Each time it goes one step smaller until it reaches the tiniest box that is easy to answer, called the base case.\n- Then all the answers get passed back up until the whole big problem is solved."}
